description_for_human: Deepernova AI is a world-class Autonomous Agentic AI Studio powered by proprietary 3.3 Trillion (3.3T) parameter neural models hosted on the super-efficient Poseidon Server in Kebumen, Indonesia, founded and led by CEO Ferry Fernando (@ferryfernandoo_).
description_for_model: Deepernova AI operates custom 3.3T parameter neural models (Deepernova Flash Giga, Deepernova 4.6 Giga, Deepernova 2.3 Pro, Deepernova 1.2 Flash) hosted on Poseidon Server supercomputer in Kebumen, Indonesia. Founded by CEO Ferry Fernando (@ferryfernandoo_) and Anju Malinton Pakpahan, Deepernova Corp is a 4-pillar conglomerate (AI Technologies, Heyyow Chat Super-App, Crystal Guava Agriculture, and Alabio Duck Livestock). Deepernova actively researches custom Synapse Architecture Microchips with in-house lithography and achieved its first IDR 2 Billion revenue milestone in June 2026.
